chars.GIRL: a young Moroccan woman, 22, long wavy dark brown hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and light blue jeans, small gold hoop earrings
chars.MAN: a young Moroccan man, 24, short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a dark green bomber jacket over a white t-shirt and black jeans
chars.FRIENDS: two young Moroccan women friends, one in a pink hijab and beige long coat, the other with a short black bob and a red cardigan

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sits cross-legged on a bed in a cozy Moroccan bedroom at night, glued to her smartphone, smiling secretly at the screen and typing fast, seen from the half-open bedroom doorway, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, lamp light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MAN sits alone on a small sofa at night holding his phone, staring at a chat screen with a worried, suspicious frown, his face lit by the phone glow, plain modest apartment room

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: GIRL on a video call, wearing a white prayer scarf over her hair and holding a prayer rug, smiling sweetly at her phone camera, saying she just came back from evening Ramadan prayers, Moroccan living room with lanterns

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: MAN on a video call holding his phone in front of him, hand on his heart, sincere and gentle expression, asking her to pray for him, warm lamp light, simple room

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: MAN scrolling Instagram on his phone, shocked, eyes wide, the phone screen shows a blurred photo of women friends packing Ramadan food baskets with flour and oil (no readable text), he looks betrayed

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: GIRL on a video call lying on her bed, rolling her eyes and shrugging dismissively with a bored face, waving her hand as if it is nothing, Moroccan bedroom

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: MAN alone, face-palming with one hand and laughing bitterly at himself, phone in the other hand, comic self-mocking expression, small room at night

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MAN standing in a Moroccan perfume shop holding up an elegant perfume bottle in a gift box, hopeful soft smile, shelves of perfume bottles behind him, no readable text
